Lionel Messi expresses doubts about football future after father's death

Football star Lionel Messi has expressed serious doubts about continuing his playing career following the recent death of his father, Jorge. Messi shared his thoughts in an emotional tribute, questioning how much longer he will play. The news comes after his father's passing last week. Other football figures, including Cristiano Ronaldo, have sent messages of support to Messi.
